content: Solomonangka Godumu box Godundumunbu bayanba yijarrin.
King Solomonangka Israel-warra maja-maja yiringkurrmun kunjan, townbu Jerusalem kadanka. Jana wubulku murumarin, jana priest-warrangka Godumu box jarra-kulban tentmun, Godundumunbu bayanba yijarrin.

Wawu yinyamun Solomon jakalba altermunbu janan, mara jiringa wangkar-bungan, Godundu prayman. Nyulu yalaman, “Maja God Israel-warranka. Yundu God jirray bajaku. Yindu god yala yundu yamba-kari jiringa, bubungu. Yundu God bajaku, manubajaku bunday, yunuwunku bamanka wawu jirray. Kaki jana yunun wukurril, yundu jananin ngulkurrduku kujil. Yunu bama kuku nyakangarr, jana praymal yunundu.” Solomon yalaku prayman Godundu.
Yinyamun jana bamangka wubuliynjaku minya kunin, wayjun, Godundu dajin, nyungun buyay-maninka.
